name: Chant of Erosion
text:
After an ally you control is destroyed, place 1 status token on this spell if it has no status tokens on it.

[[main]] - [[exhaust]]: Remove 1 status token from this spell to attach an [[Eroding]] conjured alteration spell to a target unit.

name: Chant of Hostility
text:
After an ally you control is destroyed, place 1 status token on this spell if it has no status tokens on it.

[[side]] - [[exhaust]]: Remove 1 status token from this spell to add 1 to the attack value of a target unit you control for the remainder of the turn.

name: Crypt Guardian
text:
Unit Guard: This unit may guard a unit that is being attacked.

Shackle 1: At the end of the round or when this unit is destroyed as a result of a spell, ability, or dice power, you may place 1 exhaustion token on a target unexhausted unit.

name: Discovery
text: Attach a [[Red Raindrop]] conjured alteration spell to your Phoenixborn. Then, shuffle this card into your draw pile.

name: Era's End
text: Resolve all effects that trigger at the end of the round on unexhausted cards currently in play, in the order of your choice.

name: Eroding
text: At the end of the round, deal 1 damage to the attached unit, and then discard this spell.

name: Excavate
text: Discard 3 cards off the top of your draw pile. If you do, place 1 of them into your hand and deal 3 damage to a target unit.

name: Knowledge Seeker
text:
Seek 3: When this unit comes into play, look at the top 3 cards of your draw pile. Place each card on the top or bottom of your draw pile.

* Bequest 1: When this unit is destroyed, you may draw up to 1 card.

name: Rapture
text: Destroy an unexhausted ally you control to deal 1 damage to all units opponents control.

name: Reborn Chimera
text: Overkill 3: After this unit destroys a unit an opponent controls by attacking, deal 3 damage to that opponent's target Phoenixborn.

name: Red Raindrop
text:
At the end of the round, you may deal 1 damage to a target unit. Then, if there are 3 Red Raindrops attached to your Phoenixborn, place a [[Reborn Chimera]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

* **Spell Guard:** This spell cannot be affected by an opponent's spell.

name: Ritualist
text: Incant: When this unit comes into play, you may search your draw pile or discard pile for a ready spell with "Chant" in its title, reveal it, and place it into your hand. If you searched your draw pile, shuffle it.

name: Rowan Umberend
text:
Conscript: After an ally you control is destroyed, you may place it face down under this card, discarding any other allies underneath this card.

Exhume: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[basic]]: Place an ally that is underneath this card onto your battlefield, and then destroy it.

name: Ruin Dweller
text: **Blight 1**: At the end of the round or when this unit is destroyed as a result of an attack an opponent controls, deal 1 damage to a target Phoenixborn.

name: Summon Ruin Dweller
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[ceremonial:class]] - 1 [[time:class]]: Place a [[Ruin Dweller]] conjuration onto your battlefield.
